status: Exact warning baseline accepted for the SORA dependency removal artifact; runtime, owner notice approval and store gates remain separate.
checks: Ten prior warning artifacts were extracted from the archived pre-SORA Firefox ZIP and matched every previously accepted artifact SHA256.
All38 remaining warnings match prior code, message and description. Thirty-five bounded source contexts are byte-identical; three change only minified bindings.
Vue static-template innerHTML retains the same template element/trusted-HTML call; the other changed contexts retain the lodash global fallback and empty generator feature probe.
Four lodash/lodash.merge global fallback Function sites disappeared with the removed SORA SDK dependencies. No new warning sites were accepted.
Manifest CSP matches the previous package exactly. It permits the existing wasm-unsafe-eval, but does not permit JavaScript unsafe-eval.
Nineteen adversarial baseline-policy regressions remain required; no warning-count override or broad allowlist was added.
